description: Replaces the filters an older report's burst varies by, then writes every variant's values into its syncs again, which can take a minute, and answers the burst. A filter left out is removed with every variant's value of it, unless replace carries those values to its new filter: confirm with the user first. Variants keep their files and names. Only the burst's owner and admins may. A Rollstack report's burst varies by report parameters and returns 400.

primaryIds.description: The filters that name the variants, by their `id` in the burst's `filters` or from `listReportSyncFilters`, in the order their values name a variant. 1 to 3.

replace.description: Carries every variant's value of a filter you're replacing to its new filter, such as one moved to another dashboard. Without it, a filter left out is removed together with every variant's value of it, which can't be undone.

fromId.description: A filter the burst varies by now, by its `id` in its `filters`.

toId.description: The new filter, among `primaryIds` or `secondaryIds`, that takes its values.

secondaryIds.description: Filters a variant can also set, which don't name it.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: updateBurstFilters
title: Update burst filters
